title: Dynamic Profiles wire-format payload
description: design/developers/plugin_model.md §2-3: the FLAT shape a plugin's own backend actually exchanges with PG3/IoX -- both the `Profile` object `polyglot.getJsonProfile()` returns (§3: `{editors, nodedefs, linkdefs}`, all present) and the `update` argument `polyglot.updateJsonProfile(update, options)` takes (§2: any subset of `editors`/`nodedefs`/`linkdefs` for add/replace, plus an optional `delete` sub-object). One schema deliberately covers both use cases -- `editors`/`nodedefs`/`linkdefs` are all optional here (unlike §3's own table, which has no '(Optional)' marker on any of the three) so that a partial update call with only e.g. `nodedefs` present still validates. This is NOT the shape nucore's own Profile.load_from_json/validate_profile parse -- see nucore_profile_catalog.schema.json for that (nucore-ai's own `families[] -> instances[] -> {...}` catalog wrapper) and design/developers/nucore_domain_model.md §1/§12 for why the two differ.

editors.description: Properties and Command parameters have a reference to an editor.

nodedefs.description: Nodes each have a reference to a NodeDef ID.

linkdefs.description: NodeDefs can have a reference to LinkDefs.

delete.description: updateJsonProfile() only -- per category, '*' deletes all items in that category, or a list of ids deletes only those. Omitted or absent from a getJsonProfile() response.
